market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $45,000 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: BTC at ~$80,100 on May 9 2026. A dip to $45K requires a 44% drawdown sometime before Dec 31. While 7 months leaves room, BTC has not traded near $45K since 2024. Historical base rate for a >40% drawdown within 7 months from current levels is low absent a major macro shock.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Tail risk of severe macro/regulatory shock in 2026 H2
